SND_TR_STM_STOCK_MASTER TSTM
         INNER JOIN SND_PR_DOT_DOCUMENTTYPE PDOT
                    ON TSTM.porg_orgacode = PDOT.porg_orgacode AND TSTM.porg_orgacode = PDOT.porg_orgacode AND
                       TSTM.pdot_docmtype = PDOT.pdot_docmtype
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 EPP1
                    ON EPP1.porg_orgacode = TSTM.porg_orgacode AND EPP1.pbet_busentity_type = TSTM.pbet_busentity_type
                        AND EPP1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = TSTM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
         LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m sep1pbpl1m
                   ON sep1pbpl1m.porg_orgacode = TSTM.porg_orgacode
                       AND sep1pbpl1m.pbet_busentity_type = TSTM.pbet_busentity_type
                       AND sep1pbpl1m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = TSTM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                       AND sep1pbpl1m.plng_langCode = '@Session(languageCode)'
LEFT JOIN snd_pr_vnd_vendor PRVD
                ON TSTM.porg_orgacode = PRVD.porg_orgacode
                  AND TSTM.pvnd_vendcode = PRVD.pvnd_vendcode
LEFT JOIN snd_pr_vnd_vendor_m PRVDM
ON PRVDM.porg_orgacode = PRVD.porg_orgacode AND PRVDM.pvnd_vendcode = PRVD.pvnd_vendcode
                      AND PRVDM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
LEFT JOIN WKF_WF_WFS_WORKFLOW_STATUS WFS
ON WFS.PORG_ORGACODE =  TSTM.PORG_ORGACODE
AND WFS.WWFS_STATUS = TSTM.WF_STATUS
AND WFS.WWES_EVENT_ID='DA'
LEFT OUTER JOIN WKF_WF_WFS_WORKFLOW_STATUS_M WFSM
                         ON WFS.PORG_ORGACODE = WFSM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND WFS.WWES_EVENT_ID = WFSM.WWES_EVENT_ID
                             AND WFS.WWFS_STATUS = WFSM.WWFS_STATUS
                             AND WFSM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

SND_TR_STM_STOCK_MASTER TSTM
         INNER JOIN SND_PR_DOT_DOCUMENTTYPE PDOT
                    ON TSTM.porg_orgacode = PDOT.porg_orgacode AND TSTM.porg_orgacode = PDOT.porg_orgacode AND
                       TSTM.pdot_docmtype = PDOT.pdot_docmtype
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 EPP1
                    ON EPP1.porg_orgacode = TSTM.porg_orgacode AND EPP1.pbet_busentity_type = TSTM.pbet_busentity_type
                        AND EPP1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = TSTM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
         LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m sep1pbpl1m
                   ON sep1pbpl1m.porg_orgacode = TSTM.porg_orgacode
                       AND sep1pbpl1m.pbet_busentity_type = TSTM.pbet_busentity_type
                       AND sep1pbpl1m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = TSTM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                       AND sep1pbpl1m.plng_langCode = '@Session(languageCode)'
LEFT JOIN snd_pr_vnd_vendor PRVD
                ON TSTM.porg_orgacode = PRVD.porg_orgacode
                  AND TSTM.pvnd_vendcode = PRVD.pvnd_vendcode
LEFT JOIN snd_pr_vnd_vendor_m PRVDM
ON PRVDM.porg_orgacode = PRVD.porg_orgacode AND PRVDM.pvnd_vendcode = PRVD.pvnd_vendcode
                      AND PRVDM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

(select TXT__tssb_srno,
        DDT__tssb_balance_dateChild,
        DDL__porp_princode,
        DDL__pprd_prodcode,
        concat(asyd, ' - ', pdpp_purchase_price_pcs)                                              asyd,
        DDL__epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b,
        CategoryCd,
        CategoryDesc,
        BrandCd,
        BrandDesc,
        DDL__pbth_batch,
        DDL__pstt_stock_type,
        TXT__tssb_qty_1,
        TXT__tssb_qty_2,
        TXT__tssb_qty_3,
        TXT__tssb_qty_b_1,
        TXT__tssb_qty_b_2,
        TXT__tssb_qty_b_3,
        TXT__tssb_qty_b_4,
        TXT__tssb_qty_b_5,
        TXT__tssb_qty_c_1,
        TXT__tssb_qty_c_2,
        TXT__tssb_qty_c_3,
        TXT__tssb_qty_reserved_1,
        TXT__tssb_qty_reserved_2,
        TXT__tssb_qty_reserved_3,
        ClosingBalanceInPCS,
        floor(case query.sellFactor1
                  when 0 then 0
                  else query.ClosingBalanceInPCS / query.sellFactor1 end)                         ClosingBalanceCTN,
        floor(case query.sellFactor2
                  when 0 then 0
                  else (query.ClosingBalanceInPCS - (floor(case query.sellFactor1
                                                               when 0 then 0
                                                               else query.ClosingBalanceInPCS / query.sellFactor1 end) *
                                                     query.sellFactor1)) / query.sellFactor2 end) ClosingBalanceDZN,
        ClosingBalanceInPCS -
        (floor(case query.sellFactor1 when 0 then 0 else query.ClosingBalanceInPCS / query.sellFactor1 end) *
         query.sellFactor1) - (floor(case query.sellFactor2
                                         when 0 then 0
                                         else (query.ClosingBalanceInPCS - (floor(case query.sellFactor1
                                                                                      when 0 then 0
                                                                                      else query.ClosingBalanceInPCS / query.sellFactor1 end) *
                                                                            query.sellFactor1)) /
                                              query.sellFactor2 end) * query.sellFactor2)         ClosingBalancePCS,
        floor(case query.sellFactor1
                  when 0 then 0
                  else query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA / query.sellFactor1 end)                      ClosingBalanceCTNWOA,
        floor(case query.sellFactor2
                  when 0 then 0
                  else (query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA - (floor(case query.sellFactor1
                                                                  when 0 then 0
                                                                  else query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA / query.sellFactor1 end) *
                                                        query.sellFactor1)) /
                       query.sellFactor2 end)                                                     ClosingBalanceDZNWOA,
        ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA -
        (floor(case query.sellFactor1 when 0 then 0 else query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA / query.sellFactor1 end) *
         query.sellFactor1) - (floor(case query.sellFactor2
                                         when 0 then 0
                                         else (query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA - (floor(case query.sellFactor1
                                                                                         when 0 then 0
                                                                                         else query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA / query.sellFactor1 end) *
                                                                               query.sellFactor1)) /
                                              query.sellFactor2 end) * query.sellFactor2)         ClosingBalancePCSWOA,
        TXT__porg_orgacode,
        DDL__pptp_period_type,
        TXT__porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b,
        TXT__pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b,
        epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
        warehousedesc,
        query.PORG_ORGACODE,
        pptp_period_type,
        tssb_balance_date,
        TXT__ppa1prodanalysis3,
        TXT__ppa1prodanalysis4,
        TXT__STOCKTYPEDESC,
        pgpp_price_code,
        query.pdpp_purchase_price_pcs,
        MODIFIED_DATE,
        TXT__MOVING_AVG_PRICE
 from (select TRSB.tssb_srno                                                               as TXT__tssb_srno,
              TRSB.tssb_balance_date                                                       as DDT__tssb_balance_dateChild,
              TRSB.porp_princode                                                           as DDL__porp_princode,
              TRSB.pprd_prodcode                                                           as DDL__pprd_prodcode,
              CONCAT(TRSB.pprd_prodcode, ' - ', coalesce(prdms.pprd_desc,prdm.pprd_desc, prd.pprd_desc))   as asyd,
              TRSB.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b                                             as DDL__epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b,
              A3.ppa1_prod_analysis                                                        as CategoryCd,
              A3.ppa1_desc                                                                 as CategoryDesc,
              A5.ppa1_prod_analysis                                                           BrandCd,
              A5.ppa1_desc                                                                 as BrandDesc,
              TRSB.pbth_batch                                                              as DDL__pbth_batch,
              TRSB.pstt_stock_type                                                         as DDL__pstt_stock_type,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_1, 0)                                                 as TXT__tssb_qty_1,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_2, 0)                                                 as TXT__tssb_qty_2,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_3, 0)                                                 as TXT__tssb_qty_3,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_1, 0)                                               as TXT__tssb_qty_b_1,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_2, 0)                                               as TXT__tssb_qty_b_2,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_3, 0)                                               as TXT__tssb_qty_b_3,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_3, 0)                                               as TXT__tssb_qty_b_4,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_2, 0)                                               as TXT__tssb_qty_b_5,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_1, 0)                                               as TXT__tssb_qty_c_1,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_2, 0)                                               as TXT__tssb_qty_c_2,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_3, 0)                                               as TXT__tssb_qty_c_3,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_reserved_1, 0)                                        as TXT__tssb_qty_reserved_1,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_reserved_2, 0)                                        as TXT__tssb_qty_reserved_2,
              coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_reserved_3, 0)                                        as TXT__tssb_qty_reserved_3,
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_1, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) +
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_1, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) -
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_1, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) -
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_reserved_1, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) +
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_2, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) +
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_2, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) -
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_2, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) -
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_reserved_2, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) +
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_3, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0)) +
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_3, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0)) -
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_3, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0)) -
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_reserved_3, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0)) as ClosingBalanceInPCS,
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_1, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) +
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_1, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) -
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_1, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) +
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_2, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) +
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_2, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) -
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_2, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) +
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_3, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0)) +
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_3, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0)) -
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_3, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0))        as ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA,
              coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)                                           as sellFactor1,
              coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)                                           as sellFactor2,
              coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0)                                           as sellFactor3,
              TRSB.porg_orgacode                                                           as TXT__porg_orgacode,
              TRSB.pptp_period_type                                                        as DDL__pptp_period_type,
              TRSB.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b                                                as TXT__porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b,
              TRSB.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b                                             as TXT__pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b,
              TRSB.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
              coalesce(pp1.epp1_desc, pp1m.epp1_desc)                                      as warehousedesc,
              TRSB.PORG_ORGACODE,
              TRSB.pptp_period_type,
              TRSB.tssb_balance_date,
              PRD.ppa1_prod_analysis                                                       as TXT__ppa1prodanalysis3,
              PRD.ppa1_prod_analysis                                                       as TXT__ppa1prodanalysis4,
              CONCAT(TRSB.pstt_stock_type, ' - ', coalesce(ST.pstt_desc, STM.pstt_desc))   as TXT__STOCKTYPEDESC,
              BTH.pgpp_price_code,
              price.pdpp_purchase_price_pcs,
              TRSB.MODIFIED_DATE                                                           AS MODIFIED_DATE,
              coalesce(TRSB.TSSB_MOVING_AVG_PRICE, 0)                                      AS TXT__MOVING_AVG_PRICE
       from snd_tr_ssb_salestock_balance TRSB
                inner join snd_pr_prd_product PRD
                           on TRSB.porg_orgacode = PRD.porg_orgacode and TRSB.porp_princode = PRD.porp_princode and
                              TRSB.pprd_prodcode = PRD.pprd_prodcode and TRSB.PORG_ORGACODE = '@Session(OrgaCode)' and
                              TRSB.pbet_busentity_type = 'DIST' and
                              TRSB.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = '@Session(DIST)' and
                              TRSB.pptp_period_type = '@Model(DDL__pptp_period_type)' and
                              TRSB.tssb_balance_type = 'CL' and TRSB.tssb_period_year =
                                                                TO_CHAR(cast('@Model(DDT__tssb_balance_dateChild)' as DATE), 'YYYY') and
                              TRSB.tssb_balance_date = cast('@Model(DDT__tssb_balance_dateChild)' as DATE)
                left join snd_pr_prd_product_m prdm
                           on prd.porg_orgacode = prdm.porg_orgacode and prd.porp_princode = prdm.porp_princode and
                              prd.pprd_prodcode = prdm.pprd_prodcode and prdm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                left join snd_pr_prd_product_m prdms
                           on prd.porg_orgacode = prdms.porg_orgacode and prd.porp_princode = prdms.porp_princode and
                              prd.pprd_prodcode = prdms.pprd_prodcode and prdms.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCodeSecondary)'
                inner join snd_pr_bth_prod_batch BTH
                           on bth.porg_orgacode = TRSB.porg_orgacode and bth.porp_princode = trsb.porp_princode and
                              bth.pprd_prodcode = trsb.pprd_prodcode and bth.pbth_batch = trsb.pbth_batch
                inner join snd_pr_dpp_dist_prch_price price
                           on price.porg_orgacode = BTH.porg_orgacode and price.pbet_busentity_type = 'DIST' and
                              price.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = '@Session(DIST)' and
                              price.porp_princode = BTH.porp_princode and price.pprd_prodcode = BTH.pprd_prodcode and
                              price.pdpp_price_code = BTH.pgpp_price_code
                inner join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 pp1 on pp1.porg_orgacode = TRSB.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b and
                                                               pp1.pbet_busentity_type = TRSB.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b and
                                                               pp1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = TRSB.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b
                left join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m pp1m on pp1m.porg_orgacode = TRSB.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b and
                                                                  pp1m.pbet_busentity_type = TRSB.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b and
                                                                  pp1m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = TRSB.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b and
                                                                  pp1m.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                inner join snd_pr_stt_sku_stocktype ST
                           on ST.porg_orgacode = TRSB.porg_orgacode and ST.pstt_stock_type = TRSB.pstt_stock_type
                left join snd_pr_stt_sku_stocktype_m STM
                          on ST.porg_orgacode = STM.porg_orgacode and ST.pstt_stock_type = STM.pstt_stock_type and
                             STM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                left outer join snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 A3 on A3.porg_orgacode = PRD.porg_orgacode and
                                                                 A3.ppa1_prod_analysis = left(PRD.ppa1_prod_analysis,
                                                                                              (select length(min(p3.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                                                                                               from snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 p3
                                                                                               where p3.porg_orgacode = '@Session(OrgaCode)'
                                                                                                 and p3.ppa1_level_no = 3)) and
                                                                 A3.ppa1_level_no = 3
                left outer join snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 A5 on A5.porg_orgacode = PRD.porg_orgacode and
                                                                 A5.ppa1_prod_analysis = left(PRD.ppa1_prod_analysis,
                                                                                              (select length(min(p5.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                                                                                               from snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 p5
                                                                                               where p5.porg_orgacode = '@Session(OrgaCode)'
                                                                                                 and p5.ppa1_level_no = 5)) and
                                                                 A5.ppa1_level_no = 5) query)

(SELECT CM.porg_orgacode                                    AS ORGACODE,
        CM.pbet_busentity_type                              AS BUSTYPE,
        CM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code                        AS BUSTPHLVL1,
        CM.pdot_docmtype                                    AS DOCTYPE,
        CM.tcmm_docno                                       AS DOCNO,
        COALESCE(OUTLM.EPP1_DESC, OUTL.EPP1_DESC)           AS OUTLETCODENAME,
        CM.pdos_docmstatus                                  AS DOCST1,
        STSM.PDOS_DESC                                      AS STSNAME,
        EXS.pexs_execution_status                           AS pexs_execution_status,
        EXS.pexs_desc                                       AS pexs_desc,
        cast(TCMM_DOCM_DATE AS DATE)                        AS DOCMDT,
        CM.TCMM_NET_AMT_FCY                                 AS NETAMTFCY,
        CM.EPL1_BUSENT_CODE_LOG_LVL1_L                      AS BUSCODLOGLVL1,
        CM.EPJP_PJPNO_DAILY                                 AS PJPNODLY,
        CM.EPJP_PJPNO_DAILY_DELIVERY                        AS PJPNODLYDLV,
        CM.TCMM_DELIVERY_DATE                               AS DLVDT,
        '@Model(DELIVERYDATE)'                              AS DELIVERYDATE,
        CM.MODIFIED_DATE                                    AS MODIFIED_DATE,
        CONCAT(CM.PCMT_CASHMEMO_TYPE, ' - ', CMT.PCMT_DESC) AS CASHMEMO_TYPE,
        CM.CREATE_DATE         AS CREATE_DATE
 FROM SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_MASTER CM
          INNER JOIN SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 OUTL
                     ON CM.PORG_ORGACODE = OUTL.PORG_ORGACODE AND
                        CM.PORG_ORGACODE_PHS_LVL1_C = OUTL.PORG_ORGACODE AND
                        CM.PBET_BUSENT_TYPE_PHS_LVL1_C = OUTL.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE AND
                        CM.EPP1_BUSENT_CODE_PHS_LVL1_C = OUTL.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
          INNER JOIN SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1_M OUTLM ON OUTL.PORG_ORGACODE = OUTLM.PORG_ORGACODE AND
                                                             OUTL.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = OUTLM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE AND
                                                             OUTL.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = OUTLM.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE AND
                                                             OUTLM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'
          INNER JOIN SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS STS
                     ON CM.PORG_ORGACODE = STS.PORG_ORGACODE AND CM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = STS.PDOT_DOCMTYPE AND
                        CM.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS = STS.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS
          INNER JOIN SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS_M STSM
                     ON STS.PORG_ORGACODE = STSM.PORG_ORGACODE AND STS.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = STSM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE AND
                        STS.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS = STSM.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS AND STSM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'
          INNER JOIN SND_PR_DOT_DOCUMENTTYPE dtype
                     on cm.porg_orgacode = dtype.porg_orgacode and cm.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = dtype.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
          INNER JOIN GLB_PR_EXS_EXECUTION_STATUS EXS
                     ON CM.porg_orgacode = EXS.porg_orgacode
                         AND CM.pdot_docmtype = EXS.pdot_docmtype
                         AND CM.pexs_execution_status = EXS.pexs_execution_status
          LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_CMT_CASHMEMO_TYPE CMT
                          ON CM.PORG_ORGACODE = CMT.PORG_ORGACODE
                              AND CM.PCMT_CASHMEMO_TYPE = CMT.PCMT_CASHMEMO_TYPE
